title: 1번: Why a Bank Run Causes Bankruptcy
fullPassage: People sometimes worry that a bank will run out of money. So they all panic and try to withdraw their money. This is called a bank run. In some cases, it can cause a bank to go bankrupt. The reason for this is that most banks keep a limited amount of money in their safes. They do this for security purposes. The amount is only a small percentage of the total deposits made by customers. Therefore, if a bank run occurs, the bank must find a way to increase the amount of cash they have on hand. One way that they can do this is by selling their assets. These sales must be done quickly, so the price of the assets is likely to be much lower than normal. This can cause even more customer anxiety, leading to increased withdrawals.
